privacy.title: Privacy Policy · Arizona Pet Waste
privacy.description: How Arizona Pet Waste collects, uses and protects your data. We never sell it, we use no ad trackers, and you can ask us to see, fix or delete it.

accessibility.description: Arizona Pet Waste aims to meet WCAG 2.2 level AA. Our site works with screen readers and keyboards. Need help? Call or text 623.309.6104 to sign up by phone.
